item.title: ‘THAT’S MY JOB,’ SAYS MATCHWINNER OXLADE-CHAMBERLAIN
item.description: WITH one sweep of his right foot, Alex Oxlade-Chamberlain became an instant hit with the Celtic fans at Parkhead last night. item.title: ‘POSITIVE SIGN,’ McGREGOR HAILS HOOPS
item.description: CALLUM McGREGOR applauded the never-say-die spirit of his team-mates after another late, late show in Celtic’s tension-laden 2-1 win over Livingston at Parkhead last night. item.title: NICOLSON IN CHARGE
item.description: DUNCAN NICOLSON will be in charge of Celtic’s crucial Premiership encounter with Kilmarnock at Rugby Park on Sunday afternoon. He will be assisted by Scott Anderson and Alastair Taylor on the touchlines while Greg Aitken will be at the VAR controls.
